decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w5' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8886. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.088); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.942.
